result.summary: Identified minor to major visual and UI inconsistencies including a missing navigation icon and truncated card text.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon above the label.
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate receipt or bag icon above the 'Orders' label to match other nav items.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' under 'Fastest near you' is cut off abruptly without proper ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Allow two lines for restaurant names or add text truncation with ellipsis.
